reviews.text:
I've been going to AllPets since I adopted Bobo, and Nicole and her team have been amazing. As a first-time dog owner, they've always been there to answer my questions and provide support whenever I needed it.
The service is friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. I highly recommend AllPets to any pet owner. 🐕 🐶 🦮
Super kind, helpful and knowledgeable! thanks Nicole and Julie :)
Cool

Best pet store, hands down. The staff are amazing, helpful in every way.  I can't say enough. Accommodating. Rarely do they not have what I need and if they don't they order it right away! It comes in quickly and I always get a call. Customer service goes a along way for me. People who care and are  well informed about their product. Helping you find the best bang for your buck. Offering a discount if they can. I mean, I am happy every time I leave this store and had  to leave this review Highly recommend!!!
Love that you close whenever you want instead of your posted hours

This store is my favourite downtown pet shop. It used to be an amazing, a hidden gem of a pet store, and don’t get me wrong, it is still a great 5 star store, but it isn’t quite the same as it used to be. Since they moved locations from the smaller basement store to the much larger ground level location, I’ve noticed that there’s less consistency with staff knowledge, product samples, and offering treats to my dog when we come in to shop. It’s not that it’s bad at all, just less consistency. It’s still probably the best pet store in downtown Toronto, and they do go above and beyond when you speak to specific staff members, and they’ll bring in whatever you ask for if it’s within reason.
Every staff member is amazing. They are so friendly, knowledgeable and super helpful.
Very nice people
Terrific store. Great staff. Treats are quite pricey
Very knowledgeable. Very helpful. Extremely friendly. Will definately be back!!
Staff is friendly and decent number of options for a smaller pet store :)

So much variety
Friendly service
10/10 recommend

Best pet store I've ever been to. Every staff member is so kind and helpful and really makes you feel like they care. They also give out nice samples which my kitty has been enjoying :D (pictured chowing down)
Fantastic store! Very friendly and helpful staff and a great product selection. Love being able to collect points on purchases. Highly recommend!
First time at All Pets, I was greeted by Nicole the store manager. She was so helpful, many great suggestions for Bailey ❤️

I came in to the store today to pick up food for my roommates cat. I wasn't sure what I needed to get or where to find it. Thankfully, I was greeted by a very friendly staff member, Nicole, who was able to immediately bring me to the correct section and run me through my options. I found Nicole to be very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the care of animals, which gave me a lot of confidence that I had come to the right place.
I will be recommending this amazing local business to all of my friends.
Thanks again!

AllPets on Church is a great pet store that meets the needs of the community both with a wide range of products, knowledgeable staff, and their own unique character that adds to the village. In particular, I’d like to shoutout to NICOLE who, literally, saved my dog’s life. My dog was 20 lbs overweight and as an old dog, she was developing arthritis and breathing and the vet told me weight had to come off. Nicole helped me with time and time again advice on how to drop weight on ANY dog in a healthy, satisfying, and comprehensive way. She was there to answer my questions and helped me find the right products to make it happen. And I am happy to say my furbaby dropped 15lbs in four months and she never was hungry or overworked. If it wasn’t for Nicole, my dog would have progressed with her weight aggregated, old age problems like arthritis and breathing and growing lipomas (fat tumors). I owe a debt of gratitude to Nicole that I will never be able to repay. However, what I can do is say thank you, remain a loyal customer, and shout her praises from the rooftop (or here online works too haha)! I’ll never go anywhere else - and while Nicole was my go to person, all the staff are knowledgeable and helpful at different times. Shout out to Emanuel, Casey, Steve, Noel, Abraham, and Julie!! But NICOLE, if you’re reading this - thank you!!

I can’t say enough good things about this pet store and their incredible customer service. I’ve had multiple positive experiences here, but today truly stood out. Even on New Year’s Eve, Nicole went above and beyond for me and my pet. She took the time to walk me through all of my options, answered every question with so much patience, and genuinely cared about my pet’s well-being. That kind of care means everything. I’ll only be going to this store from now on and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place that truly puts pets first.

Fantastic pet store. Tons of selection and they gave us a sample of food that our cat loved more than her regular food so we made the switch and she's never been happier. They always have what we need, are super friendly, helpful and generous. Big fan and happy to have made it our primary pet supply source.
I've been shopping here for just over a year now for my cat. I can honestly say the staff here is always super friendly and very knowledgeable.

I’ve been visiting this store for a while, and lately the experience has felt a bit overwhelming. The newer associates tend to rush over the moment you walk in, which makes the environment feel pushy rather than welcoming. I appreciate help, but sometimes it’s nice to have a moment to look around without being approached immediately.

There are a couple of team members whose presentation and attitude could be improved. One associate, Casey, often appears unprepared for customer-facing work, which affects the overall atmosphere ,consistently has very noticeable body odour, which makes interactions uncomfortable. Another, Nicole, is knowledgeable but tends to come across as condescending, so I’ve started avoiding coming in the evenings when she’s usually there. Even the way she speaks to staff as well it’s kind of concerning.

On a positive note, the owner is always willing to help, although at times he seems a bit distracted or not fully engaged. Recently I’ve noticed new faces in the store, which is a refreshing change and definitely a step in the right direction.

They’ve also added a security guard due to increased theft in the area. He’s very professional, doesn’t hover or follow customers around, and actually helps create a safer and more comfortable shopping experience.

Overall, the store has potential, but some improvements in customer service and staff approach would make visits much more pleasant.
I interacted with a worker named Casey. They were so unprofessional and rude, didn’t provide any help whatsoever. Never coming here again
Steven was amazing. He is very knowledgeable. My cat wasn’t eating for days he recommended the best food for her to try. Amazing experience overall

It is always a pleasant shopping experience here. The staff are consistently friendly, knowledgeable, and helpful without being in your face. They have a decent rewards program that doesn’t require you download another app, and they often give a free sample for your pet when you pay at the counter. Great selection of pet food and other products. I did however significantly overpay for a backpack style cat carrier recently but I was desperate and thankful they had the carrier when I needed it urgently. Very friendly vibe — oh and great cat grass at a good price too
Nice
Great selection and super friendly and knowledgeable staff
Amazing experience! All three staff very helpful, kind and friendly. Mimi says thank you for the free treat 🐈 …
One of my favourite local businesses, the staff are always so kind and helpful, and the prices are very reasonable, especially for my cats favourite toys!
A great pet store with a wide selection and staff who truly care about animals.
Such a beautiful store, and the staff are just, incredible!!
Amazing customer service, staff are very helpful and friendly!
Super friendly staff. Great selection and prices!!!
The staff and selection of food, treats and everything else is amazing. Always a smile and a treat for our fur babies. 10 stars ⭐️

Great local business! Prices are fair, selection is good, and lots of unique inventory. The customer service is next level. I tried a few different pet stores before coming here to find my dog a harness. She's a greyhound so they are hard to fit, and every other pet store didn't allow me to try the harness on my dog for size in the store before purchasing.

All Pets carefully removed the harness from the packaging and let my dog try it on, being a great fit and $10 less than similar harnesses elsewhere, I bought it for my girl.

Every time I bring my dog here, the staff greet us both warmly and give her treats. I always get a free food/treat sample at checkout too!

Basically a perfect pet store and happy it's in my neighbourhood. We'll be customers for a long time. :)
